declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Public),
  0 < p.n →
    ∀ (tau : Fin p.n → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin p.n), 0 < tau i) →
        ∀ {Ω : Type} (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point p.d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point p.d)
          (j : Fin (p.horizon + 1)) (seeds : ℕ → Ω) (r : ℕ),
          have s := OracleTemplate.Rennala.workerState p tau g j seeds r;
          have z := OracleTemplate.Rennala.skeleton p tau r;
          s.iteration = z.iteration ∧
            s.count = z.count ∧
              s.clock = z.clock ∧
                ∀ (i : Fin p.n), (s.jobs i).started = (z.jobs i).started ∧ (s.jobs i).tag = (z.jobs i).tag
